package flowexperiment

import (
	"context"
	"reflect"
	"slices"
	"testing"

	"github.com/npillmayer/khipu"
	"github.com/npillmayer/khipu/contracts"
	"github.com/npillmayer/khipu/dimen"
	"github.com/npillmayer/khipu/helpers"
	"github.com/npillmayer/typography/glyphing/paragraph"
	"github.com/npillmayer/typography/layout"
)

type flowResult struct {
	a, b, tail   *layout.Fragment
	status       outcome
	overfull     []int // Index in the combined logical line sequence.
	work         paragraph.FlowWork
	result       *paragraph.Result // Complete candidate owner; A keeps the old owner.
	suffixPolicy paragraph.Breaker
}

// flowToFrames is test-only orchestration, never a production dispatcher. All
// boundaries are eligible. E2 always names its first-fit suffix policy explicitly.
func flowToFrames(ctx context.Context, p *paragraph.Prepared, seed *paragraph.FlowSeed, ha float64, wb dimen.DU, hb float64, resume bool) (*flowResult, error) {
	if ctx == nil || !bounded(ha) || !bounded(hb) || ha < 0 || hb < 0 {
		return nil, contracts.ErrIllegalArguments
	}
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if seed == nil || wb < 0 || wb >= dimen.Fil {
		return nil, contracts.ErrIllegalArguments
	}
	initial := seed.Initial()
	if initial == nil {
		return nil, contracts.ErrIllegalArguments
	}
	whole, err := paragraph.Fragment(ctx, initial.VList)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	a, _, err := take(ctx, whole, ha, new(splitResult))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	cp, err := seed.Checkpoint(ctx, a.Range().End)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	result, work, err := p.FlowContinue(ctx, seed, cp, wb, resume)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	combined, err := paragraph.Fragment(ctx, result.VList)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var remaining *layout.Fragment
	at := a.Range().End
	switch {
	case at == 0:
		remaining = combined
	case at == combined.Range().End:
		remaining, err = layout.NewFragment(ctx, combined.Frozen(), layout.LineRange{Start: at, End: at}, layout.Box{}, nil, nil, nil)
	default:
		_, remaining, err = paragraph.SplitFragment(ctx, combined, at)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	b, tail, err := take(ctx, remaining, hb, new(splitResult))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	out := &flowResult{a: a, b: b, tail: tail, result: result, work: work, suffixPolicy: paragraph.FirstFit}
	for _, f := range []*layout.Fragment{a, b, tail} {
		if err := checkLocalGeometry(ctx, f); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		for _, line := range f.Lines() {
			if line.Horizontal.Width > line.Horizontal.TargetWidth {
				out.overfull = append(out.overfull, line.OriginalIndex)
			}
		}
	}
	if tail.Range().Start != tail.Range().End {
		out.status = moreFrames
		if len(a.Lines()) == 0 && len(b.Lines()) == 0 {
			out.status = noProgress
		}
	}
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return out, nil
}

func flowConfig(c *serviceCalls) khipu.Config {
	params := khipu.DefaultParams()
	params.SpaceShrinkPercent = 0
	params.SpaceStretchPercent = 0
	return khipu.Config{Params: &params, Streaming: &khipu.StreamingConfig{
		Resolver: countedResolver{c}, Defaults: contracts.ResolvedRunStyle{Font: countedFont{helpers.NewSyntheticFont(), c}, EmSize: 10 * dimen.BP},
		NewShaper: func() (contracts.StreamingShaper, error) {
			c.hit(1)
			s, e := helpers.NewSyntheticStreamingShaper(8)
			return countedStream{s, c}, e
		},
	}}
}
func flowRequest(breaker paragraph.Breaker) paragraph.LayoutRequest {
	return paragraph.LayoutRequest{Params: paragraph.Params{
		Constraints: paragraph.Constraints{Width: 40 * dimen.BP}, Breaker: breaker, Assembly: paragraph.Options{Policy: paragraph.CSSLineHeight},
		LineLayout: &paragraph.LineLayout{Default: paragraph.LineHeight{Kind: paragraph.FactorHeight, Factor: 1}},
	}, Horizontal: &paragraph.HorizontalLayout{}}
}
func flowSeed(t *testing.T, input paragraph.Input, req paragraph.LayoutRequest) (*paragraph.Prepared, *paragraph.FlowSeed, *serviceCalls) {
	t.Helper()
	c := new(serviceCalls)
	p, err := paragraph.Prepare(t.Context(), input, khipu.PrepareOptions{Hyphenation: khipu.NoHyphenation}, flowConfig(c))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	seed, err := p.FlowStart(t.Context(), req)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return p, seed, c
}
func noBaseShaping(t *testing.T, before, after [7]int64) {
	t.Helper()
	for _, i := range []int{1, 2, 3} {
		if before[i] != after[i] {
			t.Fatalf("base production/acceptance repeated: %v -> %v", before, after)
		}
	}
}

func TestE2WidthsAndFixedPrefixes(t *testing.T) {
	for _, breaker := range []paragraph.Breaker{paragraph.FirstFit, paragraph.KnuthPlass} {
		p, seed, c := flowSeed(t, textInput("aa bb cc dd ee ff gg hh ii jj kk ll"), flowRequest(breaker))
		initial := seed.Initial()
		for _, cut := range []int{0, 1, 2, 3, 4} {
			for _, width := range []dimen.DU{20, 30, 50, 55} {
				if cut > len(initial.VList.Lines()) {
					continue
				}
				ha := 0.0
				if cut > 0 {
					l := initial.VList.Lines()[cut-1]
					ha = l.Top + l.Height
				}
				before := c.snapshot()
				ref, err := flowToFrames(t.Context(), p, seed, ha, width*dimen.BP, 1000, false)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(breaker, cut, width, err)
				}
				got, err := flowToFrames(t.Context(), p, seed, ha, width*dimen.BP, 1000, true)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(breaker, cut, width, err)
				}
				noBaseShaping(t, before, c.snapshot())
				compareFlow(t, initial, ref, got, cut, width*dimen.BP)
				if cut < len(initial.VList.Lines()) {
					w, r := got.work, ref.work
					if w.PrefixSearch != 0 || w.Search+w.BoundPrefix != w.Bound || r.Search != r.Bound || r.PrefixSearch != w.BoundPrefix ||
						w.Materialized != w.Bound || w.MaterializedPrefix != w.BoundPrefix || w.Bound != r.Bound || w.BoundaryChecks != cut {
						t.Fatalf("incorrect work accounting: resumed=%+v reference=%+v", w, r)
					}
					t.Logf("prefix=%s cut=%d B=%s: search prefix/total=%d/%d reference=%d/%d bind=%d/%d materialize=%d/%d assemble=%d", breaker, cut, width*dimen.BP, w.PrefixSearch, w.Search, r.PrefixSearch, r.Search, w.BoundPrefix, w.Bound, w.MaterializedPrefix, w.Materialized, w.AssembledLines)
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

func compareFlow(t *testing.T, initial *paragraph.Result, ref, got *flowResult, cut int, width dimen.DU) {
	t.Helper()
	if got.status != ref.status || got.suffixPolicy != paragraph.FirstFit || !reflect.DeepEqual(got.overfull, ref.overfull) {
		t.Fatal("policy/status changed")
	}
	compareCompleted(t, ref.result, got.result)
	if got.a.Frozen() != initial.Frozen || len(got.a.Lines()) != cut {
		t.Fatal("accepted prefix owner lost")
	}
	for i, l := range got.a.Lines() {
		if l.Line != initial.VList.Lines()[i] || l.Line != got.result.VList.Lines()[i] {
			t.Fatal("accepted geometry changed", i)
		}
	}
	for k := 0; k < prefixKnots(initial, cut); k++ {
		compareKnot(t, initial.Frozen, got.result.Frozen, k)
	}
	var oldAtomics, newAtomics []layout.AtomicPlacement
	for _, a := range initial.VList.AtomicPlacements() {
		if a.Line < cut {
			oldAtomics = append(oldAtomics, a)
		}
	}
	for _, a := range got.result.VList.AtomicPlacements() {
		if a.Line < cut {
			newAtomics = append(newAtomics, a)
		}
	}
	if !slices.Equal(oldAtomics, newAtomics) || !slices.Equal(oldAtomics, got.a.AtomicPlacements()) {
		t.Fatal("accepted atomic placement/order changed", oldAtomics, newAtomics, got.a.AtomicPlacements())
	}
	if got.b.Range().Start != cut || got.tail.Range().Start != got.b.Range().End || got.tail.Range().End != len(got.result.VList.Lines()) {
		t.Fatal("lost suffix/tail")
	}
	for _, f := range []*layout.Fragment{got.b, got.tail} {
		if f.Frozen() != got.result.Frozen {
			t.Fatal("continuation owner lost")
		}
		for _, l := range f.Lines() {
			if l.Horizontal.TargetWidth != width {
				t.Fatal("wrong suffix width")
			}
		}
	}
	var end uint64
	fills := 0
	for i, l := range got.result.VList.Lines() {
		if l.Horizontal.Source.Start != end {
			t.Fatal("lost source correspondence")
		}
		end = l.Horizontal.Source.End
		for k := l.Horizontal.FirstKnot; k < l.Horizontal.FirstKnot+l.Horizontal.KnotCount; k++ {
			knot, _ := got.result.Frozen.Knot(k)
			if knot.Material == khipu.ParagraphFillMaterial {
				fills++
				if i != len(got.result.VList.Lines())-1 {
					t.Fatal("new paragraph fill at region cut")
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if end != got.result.Frozen.SourceLen() || fills != 1 {
		t.Fatal("lost source/trailer", end, fills)
	}
}
func prefixKnots(r *paragraph.Result, cut int) int {
	if cut == 0 {
		return 0
	}
	l := r.VList.Lines()[cut-1].Horizontal
	return l.FirstKnot + l.KnotCount
}
func compareCompleted(t *testing.T, a, b *paragraph.Result) {
	t.Helper()
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(a.BreakPositions, b.BreakPositions) || !reflect.DeepEqual(a.BidiRuns, b.BidiRuns) ||
		a.VList.Box() != b.VList.Box() || !reflect.DeepEqual(a.VList.Lines(), b.VList.Lines()) ||
		!reflect.DeepEqual(a.VList.Materials(), b.VList.Materials()) || !reflect.DeepEqual(a.VList.AtomicPlacements(), b.VList.AtomicPlacements()) || a.Frozen.KnotCount() != b.Frozen.KnotCount() {
		t.Fatal("reference and resumed layout differ", a.BreakPositions, b.BreakPositions)
	}
	for k := 0; k < a.Frozen.KnotCount(); k++ {
		compareKnot(t, a.Frozen, b.Frozen, k)
	}
}
func compareKnot(t *testing.T, a, b *khipu.FrozenKhipu, k int) {
	t.Helper()
	x, xok := a.Knot(k)
	y, yok := b.Knot(k)
	tx, xt := a.CopyText(k)
	ty, yt := b.CopyText(k)
	if xok != yok || x != y || xt != yt || !reflect.DeepEqual(tx, ty) {
		t.Fatal("frozen source/glyph/context changed", k)
	}
}
